headline: OJK Head Reveals Global Threats Lurking Over Indonesian Banks
summary: Indonesia's financial services authority, OJK, has outlined risks facing the country's banking industry from global challenges. The warning covers external pressures on the sector.
why: The OJK is Indonesia's financial services regulator, overseeing banks, insurers and capital markets, so its risk assessments influence bank lending and investor sentiment.
original_headline: Bos OJK Buka-Bukaan Ancaman Global yang Mengintai Bank RI
